name: RefSeq fish mitogenomes, MiFish-U amplicon
ncbi_query: Actinopteri[Organism] AND srcdb_refseq[PROP] AND biomol_genomic[PROP] AND mitochondrion[filter]
note: Each entry is the part of a fish's mitochondrial DNA between the two test markers (primers), cut out of the public RefSeq genome. A genome with no findable stretch is left out, so some fish are simply not on this list.
excluded_note: Mitogenomes named only to genus ('Genus sp.', 'cf.', 'aff.') are not species-level references and are left out.
